page.layout: One printed page, one text block. Full-width dedication title at the top, centred. Below it a woodcut initial at the left with the text wrapping to its right and below. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right, gathering signature at the foot left.

main_text.head: ILLVSTRIBVS AC GENEROSIS D. MAVRITIO & ERNESTO, fratribus germanis, comitibus in Dietz, Dominis in Lisberg & Bickenbach, &c. Dominis suis humili obseruantia colendis, S.
main_text.p: ERIT fortasse qui miretur, cur hoc Compendium Physices uel à parente meo piæ memoriæ sit conscriptum, uel nunc à me edatur. Is itaque rationem paucis accipiat. Ac primùm quidè ad parentè quod attinet, nō ignorauit ille, quàm utilia essent bonarũ ar-tiũ & philosophiæ studia, quamq; scitu ne-cessaria ijs qui in maioribus, ut uocãt, facul-tatibus cũ fructu uersari cupiunt. Quapro-pter cũ ex animo simul agnosceret, neminè sibi soli natũ esse, sed ortus nostri partè sibi patriã uendicare, partè parentes, partè ami-cos, ut est præclarè à Platone dictũ: cumq; sciret, homines hominum causa (ut Stoicis placet) esse generatos, ut ipsi inter se alij alijs

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is an engraved picture of a figure and is joined to the first word "ERIT". Printed "ut uocãt" and other abbreviations kept as printed. The page number at the head is a small mark read as 3 with doubt. The last word "alijs" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. The printed line "alij" ends the paragraph at the foot of the column.
